item.title: Repeated Flytippibg outside collection days at this spot., 13th August
item.description:
There is consistent fly tipping of domestic rubbish outside 6 & 8 Cranley Gardens SW7. This photograph was taken at 8:30 pm on Thursday. 13th of August. Fly tipping happened this week on Monday evening despite that being a K&C rubbish collection in the morning and again it has happened today with rubbish being put out despite the K&C rubbish collection having happened this morning. This is attracting other people to add rubbish to it as well as litter from passes by. This is unacceptable and it stays out overnight and foxes and birds terrorist pieces creating work for The road sweepers and also slip hazards for pedestrians. Please can you find these people as they are regular offenders. The two addresses are social housing and other tenants are getting fed up with this happens oustside their front doors. Please act.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 2, Cranley Gardens, Brompton, Greater London

item.title: Yellow lines needed, 13th August
item.description:
When the road is busy with people parking to go to the park, which is most weekends and often throughout the summer holidays, people park on this bend and on the straight side of the road opposite. This results in a narrowing of the space for cars driving through, so only one car can fit, at the same time as absolutely no view around the bend. Many times I have cautiously driven up to the bend and someone has been speeding down Thicket Road to cross over to the one way part. I have also seen traffic build up because of this and many near accidents. It is a terrible accident waiting to happen and if there were just yellow lines on both sides of the road, especially on the bend, this could be easily avoided. Please consider doing this before it is too late.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 4, Anerley Park Road, Crystal Palace, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
